notes: Raidar 1.1.6: Player Lookup now correctly pulls full live Rust stats for public profiles (fixed the PRIVATE/UNSYNCED bug - Steam stopped exposing stat values in its XML, so we now fall through to RustStats); Workflows and Sequences are integrated into Smart Devices with new custom dropdowns; Pump Jacks added to monument markers (Power Plant, Train Yard, Water Treatment); live-map notifications moved back to the top-right; a new tactical background texture fills the space around the map; and the custom user map markers were reworked into premium glossy pins.
